description.en: Natural-language middleware for DeepSeek Harness. Matches a user goal to curated capability recipes (personal site, file tidying, HTML reports, infographics, presentations), offers execution strategies (MVP-first / clarify-first), assembles the required tools and skills, executes via a Harness subagent, and records independent verification evidence.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的自然语言中间件：把用户目标匹配到内置能力方案（个人网站、文件整理、HTML 报表、信息图、演示文稿），提供执行策略选择（先跑 MVP / 先对齐需求），装配所需工具与技能后交由 Harness 子代理执行，并产出独立验证证据。
